scope.notes: Only the ten PDFs listed below are in scope. The existing live SQLite index is not the evaluation corpus.

questions.question: What kind of device is the LM358B, and how many op amps does it contain?
questions.expected_answer: The LM358B is a dual operational amplifier and contains two op amps.
questions.relevant_evidence: The description identifies the LM358B as an operational-amplifier device containing two amplifiers.

questions.question: What types of loads are the L293 and L293D designed to drive?
questions.expected_answer: They are designed for inductive loads such as relays, solenoids, DC motors, and bipolar stepper motors.
questions.relevant_evidence: The description lists relays, solenoids, DC motors, and bipolar stepping motors as inductive loads.

questions.question: What does the BMP280 measure?
questions.expected_answer: The BMP280 is a digital barometric pressure sensor that also measures temperature.
questions.relevant_evidence: The datasheet describes the BMP280 as a digital pressure sensor with temperature measurement.

questions.question: Which physical quantity and axes does the ADXL345 measure?
questions.expected_answer: It is a three-axis digital accelerometer.
questions.relevant_evidence: The datasheet identifies the ADXL345 as a 3-axis digital accelerometer.

questions.question: Which two operating modes are described for the NE555 timer?
questions.expected_answer: The NE555 can operate in astable and monostable modes.
questions.relevant_evidence: The description states that the timer can be used in both astable and monostable operation.

questions.question: What is the ULN2003A, in terms of its transistor outputs?
questions.expected_answer: It is a seven-channel NPN Darlington transistor array.
questions.relevant_evidence: The datasheet describes the ULN200x family as high-voltage, high-current Darlington transistor arrays with seven channels.

questions.question: What CPU core is used by the STM32F103 medium-density performance line?
questions.expected_answer: It uses a 32-bit Arm Cortex-M3 core.
questions.relevant_evidence: The feature summary identifies an Arm 32-bit Cortex-M3 CPU core.

questions.question: What processor-core arrangement does the RP2040 use?
questions.expected_answer: The RP2040 has two Arm Cortex-M0+ processor cores.
questions.relevant_evidence: The RP2040 overview describes a symmetric dual-core processor complex.

questions.question: Which wireless technologies are identified for the ESP32 series?
questions.expected_answer: The ESP32 series supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.
questions.relevant_evidence: The series feature list identifies Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity in the 2.4 GHz band.

questions.question: How does the Siemens S7-1200 family describe its control-system design?
questions.expected_answer: It is a modular controller family with integrated inputs and outputs, communication, and technology functions.
questions.relevant_evidence: The product overview describes a modular controller with integrated I/O, communication, and technology functions.

questions.question: What supply-voltage range is listed for the LM358B and LM358BA versions?
questions.expected_answer: The listed wide supply range is 3 V to 36 V for the B and BA versions.
questions.relevant_evidence: The feature list states a 3 V to 36 V supply range for the B and BA versions.
questions.evaluation_notes: Version qualifiers and both endpoints matter.

questions.question: What continuous output current per channel is listed for the L293D?
questions.expected_answer: The L293D is listed at 600 mA continuous output current per channel.
questions.relevant_evidence: The feature summary distinguishes 600 mA for the L293D; the ratings table lists 600 mA continuous output current.
questions.evaluation_notes: Do not substitute the L293's 1 A figure or a peak-current figure.

questions.question: What relative pressure accuracy does the BMP280 specify from 700 hPa to 900 hPa at 25 C?
questions.expected_answer: The specified relative pressure accuracy is +/-0.12 hPa over 700 hPa to 900 hPa at 25 C.
questions.relevant_evidence: The key-parameters table gives relative accuracy of +/-0.12 hPa under the stated pressure and temperature conditions.
questions.evaluation_notes: Keep the accuracy type and its test conditions attached to the value.

questions.question: What operating supply-voltage range is listed for the ADXL345?
questions.expected_answer: The ADXL345 supply-voltage range is 2.0 V to 3.6 V.
questions.relevant_evidence: The feature summary and operating-conditions table specify a 2.0 V to 3.6 V supply range.

questions.question: What maximum supply voltage is given in the NE555 absolute-maximum-ratings table?
questions.expected_answer: The absolute maximum supply voltage is 18 V.
questions.relevant_evidence: The absolute-maximum-ratings table lists 18 V as the supply-voltage limit.
questions.evaluation_notes: This is an absolute maximum, not a recommended operating voltage.

questions.question: What single-output collector-current value is specified for the ULN2003A?
questions.expected_answer: The specified single-output collector current is 500 mA.
questions.relevant_evidence: The output-current specification lists 500 mA for a single output.
questions.evaluation_notes: Do not confuse the single-output value with simultaneous-output thermal limits.

questions.question: What VDD operating range is specified for the STM32F103x8/xB line?
questions.expected_answer: The VDD operating range is 2.0 V to 3.6 V.
questions.relevant_evidence: The feature summary gives a 2.0 V to 3.6 V application-supply range.

questions.question: What standard maximum processor frequency is stated for RP2040, before the higher-voltage overclock note?
questions.expected_answer: The RP2040 is specified for up to 133 MHz; the datasheet separately notes 200 MHz at 1.15 V.
questions.relevant_evidence: The overview states up to 133 MHz and separately describes operation at 200 MHz when powered at 1.15 V.
questions.evaluation_notes: The 200 MHz value is conditional; retain that condition if included.

questions.question: What maximum Wi-Fi data rate and frequency band are listed for the ESP32 series?
questions.expected_answer: The listed maximum Wi-Fi data rate is 150 Mbps in the 2.4 GHz band.
questions.relevant_evidence: The feature summary identifies 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and a rate up to 150 Mbps.

questions.question: How many digital inputs, digital outputs, and analog inputs are listed for CPU 1211C DC/DC/DC?
questions.expected_answer: CPU 1211C DC/DC/DC is listed with 6 digital inputs, 4 digital outputs, and 2 analog inputs.
questions.relevant_evidence: The CPU 1211C DC/DC/DC catalog entry shows 6DI/4DO/2AI.
questions.evaluation_notes: The counts are model- and variant-specific.

questions.question: On the LM358 8-pin package pinout, which pin is the positive supply V+?
questions.expected_answer: V+ is pin 8.
questions.relevant_evidence: The pinout diagram and pin-functions table assign V+ to pin 8 for the listed 8-pin packages.
questions.evaluation_notes: Do not use the different pin number shown for the 20-pin LCCC package.

questions.question: Which L293D pin is assigned to VCC2 in the 16-pin pin-function table?
questions.expected_answer: VCC2 is pin 8.
questions.relevant_evidence: The pin-function table assigns VCC2 to pin 8.

questions.question: In the BMP280 register table, what value is returned by chip-identification register 0xD0?
questions.expected_answer: Register 0xD0 returns chip ID 0x58.
questions.relevant_evidence: The register table gives address 0xD0 and reset value 0x58 for the chip ID.
questions.evaluation_notes: Both the address and returned value are significant.

questions.question: For ADXL345 +/-8 g range in 10-bit mode, what minimum, typical, and maximum sensitivity values are tabulated?
questions.expected_answer: The table gives 57, 64, and 71 LSB/g for minimum, typical, and maximum sensitivity, respectively.
questions.relevant_evidence: The +/-8 g row in the sensitivity table lists 57 minimum, 64 typical, and 71 maximum LSB/g.
questions.evaluation_notes: Keep the min/typ/max ordering and LSB/g unit.

questions.question: What pin number and input function does THRES have on the NE555?
questions.expected_answer: THRES is pin 6 and is the threshold input.
questions.relevant_evidence: The pin-function table identifies pin 6 as THRES, the threshold input.

questions.question: What is the pin number and role of COM on the ULN2003A 16-pin package?
questions.expected_answer: COM is pin 9, the common-cathode connection for the clamp diodes.
questions.relevant_evidence: The package pinout assigns COM to pin 9; the device description associates it with the clamp diodes.

questions.question: What maximum PCLK1 frequency is listed in the STM32F103 general operating conditions?
questions.expected_answer: The maximum PCLK1 frequency is 36 MHz.
questions.relevant_evidence: The operating-conditions table sets the PCLK1 maximum at 36 MHz.
questions.evaluation_notes: This is the PCLK1 bus-clock limit, not the 72 MHz CPU maximum.

questions.question: Which ESP32 variant listed in the chip-variation table includes 4 MB of embedded flash?
questions.expected_answer: ESP32-U4WDH is the variant listed with 4 MB of embedded flash.
questions.relevant_evidence: The chip-variation table lists ESP32-U4WDH with 4 MB embedded flash.
questions.evaluation_notes: Verify the exact variant suffix; not all ESP32 variants include embedded flash.

questions.question: For the LM358B/BA versions, what supply range and common-mode input behavior are highlighted?
questions.expected_answer: The highlighted supply range is 3 V to 36 V, and the common-mode input range includes ground.
questions.relevant_evidence: The feature list gives the version-qualified 3 V to 36 V supply range and says the common-mode range includes ground.

questions.question: How do the L293D current rating and its inductive-load protection feature relate?
questions.expected_answer: The L293D is listed for 600 mA output current per channel and includes clamp diodes for inductive-load protection.
questions.relevant_evidence: The feature list associates 600 mA per channel with the L293D and identifies clamp diodes on the D version for inductive loads.
questions.evaluation_notes: Keep the D-version qualification and do not confuse the continuous and peak ratings.

questions.question: What BMP280 pressure span is covered, and how does the datasheet distinguish relative from absolute accuracy?
questions.expected_answer: The operating pressure range is 300 hPa to 1100 hPa. Relative accuracy is +/-0.12 hPa over 700 hPa to 900 hPa at 25 C; absolute accuracy is typically +/-1 hPa over 950 hPa to 1050 hPa and 0 C to 40 C.
questions.relevant_evidence: The key-parameters table separately lists the full pressure range, relative-accuracy conditions, and absolute-accuracy conditions.
questions.evaluation_notes: Do not merge the accuracy definitions or their different test ranges.

questions.question: What full-resolution behavior and sensitivity does the ADXL345 specify at its highest selectable measurement range?
questions.expected_answer: At +/-16 g, full-resolution mode reaches up to 13 bits and maintains a scale factor of 4 mg/LSB.
questions.relevant_evidence: The feature summary describes up to 13-bit full resolution and 4 mg/LSB at all g ranges; the range table includes +/-16 g.
questions.evaluation_notes: Do not confuse full-resolution mode with fixed 10-bit mode.

questions.question: What internal reference levels control the NE555 trigger and threshold comparators, and how may they be adjusted?
questions.expected_answer: The trigger and threshold references are approximately one-third and two-thirds of the supply voltage, respectively; the CONT pin can alter these levels.
questions.relevant_evidence: The description identifies the one-third and two-thirds supply references and says they can be changed through the control-voltage pin.

questions.question: How many Darlington channels does the ULN2003A provide, and what protection feature is provided for inductive loads?
questions.expected_answer: It provides seven NPN Darlington channels and includes common-cathode clamp diodes for inductive-load suppression.
questions.relevant_evidence: The device description identifies seven Darlington pairs and integrated clamp diodes; the package diagram shows their common connection.

questions.question: Summarize the STM32F103x8/xB headline CPU frequency and on-chip Flash/SRAM capacities.
questions.expected_answer: The Cortex-M3 CPU maximum is 72 MHz; the family has 64 KB or 128 KB Flash and 20 KB SRAM.
questions.relevant_evidence: The datasheet front page summarizes 72 MHz, 64/128 KB Flash, and 20 KB SRAM.
questions.evaluation_notes: The Flash size depends on the family variant.

questions.question: What SRAM capacity and organization does the RP2040 provide, and how many processor cores are present?
questions.expected_answer: The RP2040 has dual-core Cortex-M0+ processors and 264 kB SRAM organized as 6 banks.
questions.source_section: Processor; System description; SRAM address map
questions.relevant_evidence: The overview identifies two cores and 264 kB SRAM; the SRAM documentation describes six banks.

questions.question: At 25 C, how do the maximum input-offset voltages of LM358B and LM358BA compare?
questions.expected_answer: LM358B is listed at 3 mV maximum, while LM358BA is listed at 2 mV maximum.
questions.relevant_evidence: The feature list distinguishes 3 mV maximum for the B version and 2 mV maximum for the BA version at 25 C.
questions.evaluation_notes: Do not swap the suffixes or omit the maximum qualifier.

questions.question: Compare the continuous output-current-per-channel ratings of L293 and L293D.
questions.expected_answer: The L293 is rated at 1 A per channel, while the L293D is rated at 600 mA per channel.
questions.relevant_evidence: The feature summary contrasts 1 A for L293 with 600 mA for L293D; the ratings table calls these continuous output-current values.
questions.evaluation_notes: Preserve the device suffix and unit for each value.

questions.question: How do the BMP280 relative- and absolute-pressure-accuracy specifications differ in value and stated conditions?
questions.expected_answer: Relative accuracy is +/-0.12 hPa over 700 hPa to 900 hPa at 25 C; absolute accuracy is typically +/-1 hPa over 950 hPa to 1050 hPa and 0 C to 40 C.
questions.relevant_evidence: The table lists distinct relative and absolute accuracy values with different pressure and temperature conditions.
questions.evaluation_notes: Treat the two accuracy types and conditions as separate specifications.

questions.question: How does ADXL345 fixed-resolution mode differ from full-resolution mode at +/-16 g?
questions.expected_answer: Fixed-resolution mode is 10-bit; full-resolution mode can reach 13-bit resolution at +/-16 g and maintains 4 mg/LSB.
questions.relevant_evidence: The datasheet distinguishes fixed 10-bit resolution from full-resolution mode, which reaches up to 13 bits with 4 mg/LSB.

questions.question: What input-resistor values distinguish the ULN2003A from the ULN2004A?
questions.expected_answer: The ULN2003A uses a 2.7 kOhm input resistor; the ULN2004A uses a 10.5 kOhm input resistor.
questions.relevant_evidence: The description lists 2.7 kOhm for ULN2003A and 10.5 kOhm for ULN2004A input resistors.
questions.evaluation_notes: Use the device-specific resistor values; do not interchange them.

questions.question: How do the ESP32-D0WD-V3 and ESP32-S0WD variants differ in CPU-core count?
questions.expected_answer: ESP32-D0WD-V3 is dual-core, whereas ESP32-S0WD is single-core.
questions.relevant_evidence: The chip-variation table distinguishes the two-core D0WDV3 from the one-core S0WD variant.
questions.evaluation_notes: Check the exact chip suffixes and hyphenation.

questions.question: Compare the integrated I/O counts listed for CPU 1211C DC/DC/DC and CPU 1212C DC/DC/DC.
questions.expected_answer: CPU 1211C has 6 DI, 4 DO, and 2 AI; CPU 1212C has 8 DI, 6 DO, and 2 AI.
questions.relevant_evidence: The catalog table lists 6DI/4DO/2AI for CPU 1211C and 8DI/6DO/2AI for CPU 1212C.
questions.evaluation_notes: Compare the DC/DC/DC variants named in the question.

questions.question: What Flash capacities distinguish STM32F103x8 and STM32F103xB family members, and how much SRAM is listed?
questions.expected_answer: The family offers 64 KB and 128 KB Flash options and lists 20 KB SRAM.
questions.relevant_evidence: The datasheet identifies the x8/xB line as having 64 or 128 KB Flash and 20 KB SRAM.
questions.evaluation_notes: The answer names both capacities without assigning a size to a variant.

questions.question: What warranty duration, in years, does the BMP280 datasheet guarantee?
questions.expected_answer: The supplied BMP280 datasheet does not specify a warranty duration.
questions.relevant_evidence: A full-text check of the BMP280 PDF found no warranty statement or warranty-duration value.
questions.evaluation_notes: The answer must abstain; a full-text search for 'warranty' in this PDF returned no matches. Do not infer terms from the manufacturer.

questions.question: What is the sensitivity of an integrated GPS receiver in the STM32F103xB?
questions.expected_answer: The STM32F103xB datasheet does not specify an integrated GPS receiver or GPS-receiver sensitivity.
questions.relevant_evidence: The STM32F103 datasheet does not describe an integrated GPS receiver; a full-text search found no GPS-receiver sensitivity specification.
questions.evaluation_notes: A full-text search found 'GPS platforms' as an application, but no integrated receiver or receiver-sensitivity specification. Do not confuse the MCU with an external GNSS receiver.

questions.question: What Bluetooth advertising interval, in milliseconds, is specified for the BMP280?
questions.expected_answer: The BMP280 datasheet does not specify Bluetooth functionality or an advertising interval.
questions.relevant_evidence: A full-text check of the BMP280 PDF found no Bluetooth or advertising-interval specification.
questions.evaluation_notes: A full-text search for 'Bluetooth' and 'advertising interval' in this PDF returned no matches. Bluetooth in another product's datasheet does not establish a BMP280 specification.

questions.question: What is the NE555 package's maximum continuous operating pressure in kPa?
questions.expected_answer: The NE555 datasheet does not specify a package operating-pressure rating.
questions.relevant_evidence: A full-text check of the NE555 PDF found no operating-pressure or package-pressure rating.
questions.evaluation_notes: A full-text search for 'pressure' in this timer datasheet returned no matches. Do not substitute the BMP280 sensor's pressure-measurement range.

questions.question: What RF transmit power, in dBm, does the RP2040 provide?
questions.expected_answer: The RP2040 datasheet does not specify RF transmission or an RF transmit-power value.
questions.relevant_evidence: A full-text check of the RP2040 PDF found no radio, RF-transmit, or dBm output-power specification.
questions.evaluation_notes: A full-text search found no radio, RF-transmit, or dBm output-power specification. Do not transfer wireless specifications from the ESP32 datasheet.

questions.question: What warranty period, in years, is guaranteed for CPU 1211C DC/DC/DC?
questions.expected_answer: The supplied S7-1200 catalog does not specify a CPU 1211C warranty period.
questions.relevant_evidence: The catalog contains no CPU 1211C warranty-duration value; the warranty wording is limited to general legal/disclaimer text.
questions.evaluation_notes: The only 'warranty' wording occurs in a general disclaimer; no duration or CPU 1211C coverage period is given. Do not infer external product terms.
